$comment: Bundle budgets read by tools/qa/bundle-budget.ts (docs/plan/v1/PLAN.md §2.3, PF-14 · CR-6). Bytes; the script prints KiB (1 KB = 1024 B), the unit of the plan and the audit. `gates` are absolute ceilings (firstPaint 120 KB is V1-P1, editor 900 KB is V1-P2 after PF-1). `growthCap` is the growth allowed over `baseline` per wave. `baseline` is written by `--write-baseline`, once per wave after the merge or when the owner accepts a growth.
